# sbm

The goal of the package `sbm` is to regroup into a unique framework
tools for estimating and manipulating variants of the stochastic
blockmodel.

## Installation

The last stable version is available on
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=sbm) with:

``` r

install.packages("sbm")
```

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("GrossSBM/sbm")
```

# Package index

## Simple SBM

Set of classes and functions for manipulating simple stochastic block
models

- [`SimpleSBM`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/SimpleSBM.md) :
  R6 class for Simple SBM
- [`SimpleSBM_fit`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/SimpleSBM_fit.md)
  : R6 Class definition of a Simple SBM fit
- [`sampleSimpleSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/sampleSimpleSBM.md)
  : Sampling of Simple SBMs
- [`estimateSimpleSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/estimateSimpleSBM.md)
  : Estimation of Simple SBMs

## Bipartite Stochastic block models

Set of classes and functions for manipulating bipartite stochastic block
models

- [`BipartiteSBM`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/BipartiteSBM.md)
  : R6 class for Bipartite SBM
- [`BipartiteSBM_fit`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/BipartiteSBM_fit.md)
  : R6 Class definition of an Bipartite SBM fit
- [`sampleBipartiteSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/sampleBipartiteSBM.md)
  : Sampling of Bipartite SBMs
- [`estimateBipartiteSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/estimateBipartiteSBM.md)
  : Estimation of Bipartite SBMs

## Multipartite Stochastic block models

Set of classes and functions for manipulating multipartite stochastic
block models

- [`MultipartiteSBM`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/MultipartiteSBM.md)
  : R6 Class definition of a Multipartite SBM
- [`MultipartiteSBM_fit`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/MultipartiteSBM_fit.md)
  : R6 Class definition of a Multipartite SBM fit
- [`MultiplexSBM_fit`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/MultiplexSBM_fit.md)
  : R6 Class definition of a Multiplex SBM fit
- [`sampleMultipartiteSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/sampleMultipartiteSBM.md)
  : Sampling of Multipartite SBMs
- [`estimateMultipartiteSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/estimateMultipartiteSBM.md)
  : Estimation for multipartite SBM

## Multilayer (aka Multiplex) Stochastic block models

Set of classes and functions for manipulating multiplex stochastic block
models

- [`MultiplexSBM_fit`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/MultiplexSBM_fit.md)
  : R6 Class definition of a Multiplex SBM fit
- [`sampleMultiplexSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/sampleMultiplexSBM.md)
  : Sampling of Multiplex SBMs
- [`estimateMultiplexSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/estimateMultiplexSBM.md)
  : Estimation for Multiplex SBM
- [`plotMyMultiplexMatrix()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotMyMultiplexMatrix.md)
  : Plot the matrices corresponding to a Multiplex Network

## Methods common to all SBM

Set of classes and functions for manipulating stochastic block models

- [`is_SBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/is_SBM.md) :
  Auxiliary function to check the given class of an object
- [`plot(`*`<SBM>`*`)`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plot.SBM.md)
  : SBM Plot
- [`predict(`*`<SBM>`*`)`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/predict.SBM.md)
  : Model Predictions
- [`coef(`*`<SBM>`*`)`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/coef.SBM.md)
  : Extract model coefficients
- [`fitted(`*`<SBM>`*`)`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/fitted.SBM.md)
  : Extract model fitted values
- [`defineSBM()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/defineSBM.md)
  : Define a network
- [`plotMyMatrix()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotMyMatrix.md)
  : Plot an adjacency or incidence Matrix
- [`plotMyGraphon()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotMyGraphon.md)
  : Plot the graphon of a Stochastic Block Model
- [`plotMyMultipartiteMatrix()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotMyMultipartiteMatrix.md)
  : Plot the matrices corresponding to a Multipartite Network

## Data sets

Sets of data available

- [`fungusTreeNetwork`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/fungusTreeNetwork.md)
  : fungus-tree interaction network
- [`multipartiteEcologicalNetwork`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/multipartiteEcologicalNetwork.md)
  : Ecological multipartite interaction network
- [`war`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/war.md) : War data
  set

## Others

Miscellaneous

- [`plotAlluvial()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotAlluvial.md)
  : Plot an alluvial plot between clusterings

## Virtual methods

Comprehensive list of remaning classes and methods used internally

- [`SBM`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/SBM.md) : R6 virtual
  class for SBM representation (mother class of SimpleSBM, BipartiteSBM,
  MultipartiteSBM)
- [`plotAlluvial()`](https://grosssbm.github.io/sbm/reference/plotAlluvial.md)
  : Plot an alluvial plot between clusterings
